Every moon is cut into 24 slices, one for each hour of the day. A lit slice is an hour asleep, and the higher the moon floats, the longer the sleep.

a gold slice is an hour of dreaming, the rainbow inside is the dreama drifting bubble is a story from the wild

pull the moon, and a day passes
